name: clarto-correo
description: Reads the company mailbox (info@) read-only, keeps a copy of each message and routes it: replies to property requests, owner and client replies to their timeline, new enquiries by area with a TARMIO task, advertising archived; AI only for what deterministic rules cannot place; staff review queue whose corrections become rules.
features: Read-only IMAP polling with cursor, idempotent by Message-ID
Deterministic triage (threads, SOL-/VAL- references, rules, known senders)
AI classification with a redacted excerpt
Review queue; corrections become sender or domain rules
Receipts and auto-replies never count as answers
